subject: CloudBridge marketplace addendum — pass-through fee clarification
messages:
From: Alex Rosen <alex.rosen@cloudbridge.com>
To: sean_gallagher@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Cc: legal@cloudbridge.com
Date: Mon, 1 Mar 2027 10:15:00 -0800
Subject: CloudBridge marketplace addendum - pass-through fee language

Hi Sean / Marissa,

Thanks for the demo last week — CloudBridge is excited to move forward. Our procurement team raised one question while reviewing the MSA + Order Form: the marketplace addendum you shared mentions "pass-through" of third-party marketplace surcharges but the drafting is a bit open-ended. Can you confirm:

- Whether Redwood will accept the pass-through of marketplace platform fees (e.g., cloud provider marketplace charges) without additional markup?
- If so, whether there will be a cap or notice requirement before those fees are invoiced?

Procurement attached their checklist and asked for an explicit clause we can put in our Amended Order Form. For speed, could you share a redline or suggested language? We need this for our procurement review tomorrow.

Appreciate it —
Alex
Alex Rosen
Head of Strategic Sourcing
CloudBridge Solutions
[Attachment: CloudBridge_Procurement_Checklist.pdf (pdf)]
From: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>
To: Alex Rosen <alex.rosen@cloudbridge.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, jonas_weber@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 1 Mar 2027 12:30:00 -0800
Subject: Re: CloudBridge marketplace addendum - pass-through fee language

Alex — thanks for flagging this. Attaching a redline of the addendum with two options: (A) direct pass-through of marketplace/platform fees w/ notice and itemized invoice, no markup; (B) pass-through but limited to a defined list (e.g., GCP/AWS marketplace transaction fees) and capped at X% of monthly invoice.

Key asks from our side:
- Confirm the list of marketplaces you expect us to pass through (we can add a schedule).
- Whether you require a cap or prefer a notice-and-accept flow.

Ive cc'd Jonas (legal) to comment on indemnity/audit language. If Procurement needs it quicker, Marissa can own the commercial back-and-forth.

Next steps I propose: 1) Alex confirms option A or B, 2) legal signs off on redline, 3) we upload final addendum into the HubSpot deal and send for signature.

Attaching: RDW_CloudBridge_Addendum_v1_redline.docx

Thanks,
Sean Gallagher
Head of Sales, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: RDW_CloudBridge_Addendum_v1_redline.docx (docx)]
From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
To: sean_gallagher@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Cc: Alex Rosen <alex.rosen@cloudbridge.com>, legal@cloudbridge.com
Date: Tue, 2 Mar 2027 09:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: CloudBridge marketplace addendum - pass-through fee language

Sean / team — quick legal read: the redline looks good as a starting point. A few suggested edits we'd like to propose before finalizing:

1) Audit & documentation: require Redwood to provide itemized invoices from the marketplace / reseller on request (reasonable frequency) rather than self-attestation.
2) Cap vs notice: we prefer notice + 30 days to object only if the pass-through relates to newly introduced marketplace fees. A hard cap is okay but can be limiting for extraordinary changes.
3) Indemnity carve-out: ensure marketplace pass-throughs are not treated as Redwood-originated service charges for the purposes of indemnity — include a short carve-out sentence.
4) Effective date and retroactivity: confirm that any pass-through only applies prospectively from the execution of the addendum.

Suggested language snippet (for insertion):
"Customer acknowledges that certain fees charged by third-party marketplaces or distribution channels (\"Marketplace Fees\") may be invoiced by Redwood as pass-through charges. Redwood will: (i) pass Marketplace Fees to Customer without markup; (ii) provide Customer with reasonable supporting documentation upon request; and (iii) provide at least thirty (30) days' written notice for any new Marketplace Fee introduced after the Effective Date. Marketplace Fees shall not be considered Redwood service fees for purposes of indemnity, and shall apply only prospectively."

If Alex confirms they want a cap, recommend we propose a soft cap (e.g., not to exceed 7% of monthly cloud platform costs) with an escalation clause to revisit annually.

Jonas Weber
Senior Counsel, Commercial
Redwood Inference
From: Alex Rosen <alex.rosen@cloudbridge.com>
To: jonas_weber@redwood.com, sean_gallagher@redwood.com
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, legal@cloudbridge.com
Date: Wed, 3 Mar 2027 15:20:00 -0800
Subject: Re: CloudBridge marketplace addendum - pass-through fee language

Thanks Jonas — that language looks sensible. Procurement prefers a cap for budgeting predictability. They propose a cap at 5% of the monthly invoice for Marketplace Fees but are OK with the 30-day notice for newly introduced fees. Two small asks from our side:

- Can we add a requirement for Redwood to provide a monthly line item on the invoice labeled "Marketplace Fees" with a link to the marketplace charge?
- Can you confirm these pass-throughs will not change the SLA / uptime calculations? Procurement is concerned that extra pass-throughs could change credit calculations.

We're attaching our internal procurement checklist for reference. If Redwood can accept the 5% cap and the monthly line item requirement, Procurement will greenlight and we can move to signature.

Best,
Alex
[Attachment: CloudBridge_Procurement_Checklist.pdf (pdf)]
From: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>
To: Alex Rosen <alex.rosen@cloudbridge.com>, legal@cloudbridge.com
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, jonas_weber@redwood.com, finance_billing@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 4 Mar 2027 11:10:00 -0800
Subject: Re: CloudBridge marketplace addendum - pass-through fee language

Alex — great, thanks. We can accept the 5% soft cap and will include a monthly line item on invoices that points to the underlying marketplace charge. Confirming the pass-throughs do not affect SLA uptime or credits; they are billing-only line items and will not modify service availability calculations (we will add that call-out into the addendum).

Action items:
- Jonas: finalize the clause with the carve-out and prospective-only language (target EOD Fri).
- Marissa: once legal signs off, prepare the updated addendum in HubSpot and send to CloudBridge for e-signature.
- Finance: please review the monthly line-item implementation and confirm a format for the invoice.

I have created the HubSpot deal link and a DocuSign envelope to expedite. If everyone is aligned, we should be able to have the Order Form and addendum signed by next week.

Thanks all —
Sean Gallagher
Head of Sales, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
